## 🧭 STRATEGY

Divergence: QQQ (1W: +2.97% | 1M: -0.64%) RECOVERY, SOXX (1W: +4.28% | 1M: -8.94%) RECOVERY and XBI (1W: +7.28% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY create a short-term momentum mismatch — notable but not a core-led breakdown (classify as minor/local divergence).

**10. Portfolio Direction?**

Watch VXX ~20 for complacency, HYG/LQD spread around 0.80–1.00 as a credit-health pivot, SPY holding near its 50‑DMA for risk confirmation, and XLK/XLF relative ratio around recent highs to signal style persistence.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

XLK (1W: +4.65% | 1M: +0.29%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +2.39%) ABOVE TREND showing market strength, with energy XLE (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +9.26%) and metals GLD (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +6.77%) also rallying. Key risk is short-term momentum divergence in QQQ (1W: +2.97% | 1M: -0.64%) RECOVERY / SOXX (1W: +4.28% | 1M: -8.94%) RECOVERY / XBI (1W: +7.28% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY and ongoing weakness in long-duration bonds TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.46%) BELOW TREND to monitor.
